title: Integrate TUI projection into production runbook smoke
purpose: Upgrade production runbook smoke so it proves TUI operator projections for runtime, ecosystem and support workflows.
scope: Extend production-runbook-smoke.ps1 with TUI scripted or projection checks.
Assert dashboard, ecosystem, activation preview and support bundle sections.
Assert install/stage is inert and activation remains gated.
Persist smoke evidence under workflow artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook smoke fails if TUI projection is missing required sections.
Runbook smoke fails if activation appears ungated.
Runbook smoke evidence records command outputs and hashes.
Existing functional and ecosystem replay remain compatible.
failure_modes: Runbook smoke only checks legacy projection output.
Runbook smoke does not detect missing support bundle section.
Runbook smoke depends on network or external services.
